page.overview:
Who is Construct 8?

Construct 8, also known as Worker-8, is a secret optional character from Final Fantasy Tactics. It is an robot built by an advanced ancient civilization from the days of Saint Ajora Glabados.

Construct 8 is an automaton (Steel Giant in PS1 version), a monster-type unit that can use devastating abilities at the expense of its own HP. It can be recruited in the sidequest "Secrets Beneath Goug" in chapter 4, "In the Name of Love".

Little is known about the origin of Construct 8, except that it was created to serve humans by an advanced civilization that used the Aquarius auracite to activate it. Likely due to the Cataclysm, Construct 8 ended up deactivated and buried beneath the region that became the Clockwork City of Goug until it was discovered by the machinist Besrudio Bunansa in the form of a metallic sphere.

When Ramza Beoulve and Mustadio Bunansa returned to the Goug after defeating Belias, Besrudio told him about the strange device that he had located during one of the digging expeditions underneath the city. Upon approaching the artifact, it reacted to the auracites in Ramza's possession, as Besrudio noticed a Aquarius symbol carved on the sphere.
